name: Admin Standalone Email Composer
description: Admin composes and sends branded emails from /panel/emails (not tied to a proposal). Page-level tabs (Redactar / Historial / Valores por defecto, deep-linked via ?tab=). Redactar: draggable sections with per-section Markdown toggle, file attachments, server-rendered preview of the real branded template (POST /api/emails/preview/, sandboxed iframe). Historial: paginated email history. Uses standalone endpoints: emails/send/, emails/preview/, emails/defaults/, emails/history/.
knownGaps: Spec does not exercise: add/remove/drag-reorder sections, send-error path, history entry expand/collapse, "Cargar más" pagination. Attachments split out to admin-standalone-email-attachments (2026-07-16 audit).
